Application Data.NAME: ABC Paving and Asphalt Services, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Paving and Asphalt Services, LLC specializes in providing high-quality asphalt paving, repair, and maintenance services for residential, commercial, and municipal clients. Our operations include site preparation, asphalt laying, sealcoating, and crack filling, utilizing state-of-the-art paving equipment and techniques. We prioritize safety and environmental compliance by adhering to industry regulations and maintaining up-to-date safety protocols. Our experienced team is dedicated to delivering exceptional service while minimizing weather-related delays and ensuring client satisfaction.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2023, a heavy rainstorm caused significant delays and damage to a project at 4567 Industrial Lane, resulting in a claim for $10,000. The claim was filed with the insurance company and is currently under review. Additionally, on June 15, 2022, a minor equipment malfunction led to an incident where a roller was damaged at a job site on 7890 Commercial Drive, costing $5,000 for repairs. This claim has been settled and closed.
